translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ:
“Onipa ba, ma kwadwom a ɛfa Tiro ho so.
Ka kyerɛ Tiro a ɔda ɛpo aboboano, na ɔne adwadifoɔ bebree a wɔwɔ mpoano nkuro so di edwa sɛ, yei ne asɛm a Otumfoɔ Awurade seɛ:

content.text: Wo tumidie wɔ ɛpo so akyirikyiri;
na ɛyɛɛ ahyɛn so nnua maa woɔ.
Kwabɔhɔrɔ nnua a ɛfiri Kipro mpoano
na wɔde yɛɛ wʼahyɛn abrannaa, a wɔde asonse asɛ so.
Misraim nwera papa bi a wadi mu adwini
na wɔde yɛɛ wʼahyɛn so mframatoma
wʼapono ɛne ntokua ano ntoma yɛ bibitoma ne beredumtoma
Sidonfoɔ ne Arwadfoɔ na wɔhare wʼahyɛn;
na wɔyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ wʼahyɛn mu.
Gebal adwumfoɔ adadafoɔ tenaa wʼahyɛn mu
sɛ dua dwumfoɔ a wɔtuatua ahyɛn no mu ntokuro.
Ɛpo so ahyɛn ne wɔn hyɛn mufoɔ nyinaa
baa wo nkyɛn ne wo bɛdii nsesadwa.
someeɛ sɛ asraafoɔ wɔ wʼakodɔm mu.
Wɔde wɔn akokyɛm ne dadeɛ ɛkyɛ
Wɔde wɔn akokyɛm sensɛnee wʼafasuo ho

content: “ ‘Wʼadwadideɛ a ɛmaa wo nyaa wo ho bebree enti, Tarsis ne wo dii edwa. Wɔde dwetɛ, dadeɛ, sanya ne sumpii sesaa wʼadwadideɛ.
“ ‘Helafoɔ, Tubalfoɔ ne Mesekfoɔ ne wo dii edwa. Wɔde nkoa ne kɔbere nneɛma sesaa wʼadetɔndeɛ.
“ ‘Bet Togarma mmarima de adwumayɛ apɔnkɔ, ɔsa apɔnkɔ ne mfunumu mma bɛsesaa wʼadwadideɛ.
“ ‘Roda mmarima ne wo dii edwa, na mpoano nkuro bebree yɛɛ wʼadetɔfoɔ a wɔde asonse ne duaboɔ nnua tuaa wo ka.
“ ‘Aram ne wo dii edwa ɛsiane wo nneɛma bebrebe a woyɛ nti; wɔde nsrammaboɔ, ntoma a ɛberedum, deɛ wɔadi mu adwinneɛ, nwera pa, nnenkyenema ne bota bɛsesaa wʼadwadideɛ.
“ ‘Yuda ne Israel ne wo dii edwa; wɔde ayuo a ɛfiri Minit ne krakase, ɛwoɔ, ngo ne aneneduhwam sesaa wʼadwadideɛ.
“ ‘Damasko ne wo dii edwa wɔ nsã a ɛfiri Helbon ne nnwan ho nwi a ɛfiri Sahar mu, ɛsiane nneɛma a woyɛ ne wʼadwadideɛ a ama woanya wo ho bebree enti.
Danfoɔ ne Helafoɔ a wɔfiri Usal tɔɔ wʼadwadideɛ na wɔde dadeɛ a wɔaboro, bɛwewonua ne mmɛtire sesaa wʼadetɔndeɛ.
“ ‘Dedan de apɔnkɔ so adwatoma ne wo dii edwa.
“ ‘Arabfoɔ ne Kedar mmapɔmma nyinaa yɛɛ wʼadwadifoɔ a wɔde nnwammaa, nnwennini ne mpapo ne wo dii edwa.
“ ‘Seba ne Raama adwadifoɔ ne wo dii edwa; wɔde nnuhwam ahodoɔ a ɛte apɔ, aboɔdemmoɔ ne sikakɔkɔɔ ne wo bɛdii nsesadwa.
“ ‘Haran, Kane ne Eden, adwadifoɔ a wɔfiri Seba, Asur ne Kilmad ne wo dii edwa.
Wo dwaaso hɔ, wɔde ntoma a ɛyɛ fɛ, ɔpɔwtam a ɛyɛ tuntum, adwinneɛ ahodoɔ ne ntiasoɔtoma a ɛwɔ ahosu ahodoɔ a wɔde nhoma a wɔakyinkyim abobɔ no apɔɔpɔ na ayɛ ne wo bɛdii edwa.

content.text: de wo kɔ ɛpo so akyirikyiri
nanso apueeɛ ahum bɛbubu wo mu nketenkete
wɔn a wɔtuatua wʼahyɛn mu ntokuro,
ne obiara a ɔwɔ ɛhyɛn no mu
ɛda a wo hyɛn no bɛbɔ.
ɛberɛ a wo hyɛn mufoɔ no reteateam.
Wɔn a wɔkurakura atabon no nyinaa
hyɛn akwankyerɛfoɔ ne hyɛn mufoɔ nyinaa
wɔbɛpete mfuturo agu wɔn tiri so
ne awerɛhoɔ a emu yɛ den
Ɛberɛ a wɔretwa adwo redi awerɛhoɔ no,
wɔbɛma kwadwom bi a ɛfa wo ho so sɛ:
te sɛ Tiro a ɛpo atwa ne ho ahyia yi?”
Ɛberɛ a wʼadwadideɛ kɔɔ ɛpo ahodoɔ so no
maa asase so ahemfo nyaa wɔn ho.
Afei ɛpo abubu wo mu nketenkete
ne wo amem kɔ nsuo ase.
ho adwiri wɔn wɔ wo ho;
ehu ma wɔn ahemfo ho popo
Aman no mu adwadifoɔ bɔ nsɔm gu wo so
